title: Safe internal retry and retryable conflict error
narrative: As a developer, I want conflicts surfaced as a distinct retryable error and never silently retried unsafely so that I can retry correctly.

evals.name: jepsen with internal retry
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- jepsen --workload register --internal-retry on --duration 1h --check lost-update
